_comment: Duplicate (series, series_number) groups that lint_data.py should NOT treat as blocking ERRORs, because the correct numbering is genuinely convention-dependent and awaits an owner decision. Each excused group still surfaces as a non-blocking WARN with its reason. Add an entry as {table, series, series_number, reason}; remove it once the convention is decided and the data fixed, so the position reverts to a blocking ERROR. The Foundation (internal chronology) and Black Company (The Silver Spike counted at #4) numberings were decided and applied on 2026-07-06 and need no entry.

duplicate_series_position.reason: Speaker For The Dead and Ender in Exile both sit at #2. Speaker is #2 by publication (1986); Ender in Exile (2008) was written later but is set between Ender's Game and Speaker, so it is #2 by internal chronology. Both readings are defensible and the owner excused the clash rather than pick one (2026-08-15). Surfaced only after scripts/refresh_from_live.py pulled the live library down — the previously stale books.db did not contain Ender in Exile.
